questions.text: Kishore had a precious ruby worth Rs.63,888 with him. While showing it to one of his friends, it fell down and broke into 4 pieces, the weights of which are proportional to 1 : 2 : 3 : 5. The value of each of the pieces is directly proportional to cube of its weight. What is the loss that Kishore is going to face, as the stone fell down and broke into pieces?
